title: Likes & Dislikes
description: Compare simple likes and dislikes and ask about preferences.
objectives: Compare simple likes and dislikes and ask about preferences.

stages.title: Understand the language
stages.instructions: Read the explanation, examples, common error, and recap.

blocks.text: This lesson prepares you to compare simple likes and dislikes and ask about preferences. The central language is like/love/don't like plus activities. It belongs to the practical context of free time & abilities. Focus first on meaning: decide what information the listener needs. Then choose the subject, verb form, and useful detail. At A1, keep the message short and concrete. One clear sentence is enough before the other person responds. The same language returns in the listening, repeat, speaking, exercises, and guided conversation stages.

blocks.explanation: Use this model to begin the likes & dislikes exchange.
This likes & dislikes model adds a different detail or response.

blocks.english: What do you like to do?
blocks.explanation: Use this question or response to keep the likes & dislikes exchange moving.

blocks.text: Notice the two models: “She loves dancing.” and “They don't like cooking.” They show the pattern in complete communication, not as isolated grammar. Say the model aloud, replace one detail, and check that the new sentence keeps the intended meaning. When the other person asks a follow-up question, answer directly and add a relevant detail. This makes the exchange natural while keeping the language controlled.

blocks.title: Common error
blocks.text: Do not mix the word order or verb form with another pattern. Keep the controlled form for this lesson: like/love/don't like plus activities.
